title: Austronesian Soundscapes: Performing Arts in Oceania and Southeast Asia | IIAS
text: Ramon P. Santos, Ph.D. UP Center for Ethnomusicology "The island world of the Pacific and Indian oceans, inhabited by peoples speaking Austronesian languages, has an extremely variegated cultural spectrum. This volume is organised as a musical view on the historical map of the Austronesian expansion, attempting for the first time to see how the performing arts contribute to understanding the interlinkages of this immense cultural area and thus providing a fresh and welcome view on these understudied, yet extremely diverse musical cultures."
